entries.title: Product identity, native ISA, compiler family, and compatibility architecture
entries.limitations: Runtime and ISA observations from one C550. waveSize and warpSize share one alias source; they do not establish occupancy, maximum allocatable memory, or guarantees for other products.

sources: https://developer.metax-tech.com/api/client/document/preview/编程参考/MXMACA%20C%2B%2B编程指南/曦云C500系列/3.5.3.x/split_files/c_语言扩展.html
entries.limitations: Upstream versions and the installed host version are recorded separately. Source options do not establish C550 performance.

entries.title: Event batches, logical bandwidth, and measurement boundaries
entries.limitations: Probe protocol only. An event interval with unverified runtime cache policy does not establish peak DRAM bandwidth or pure launch latency.

entries.title: C550 copy configurations: four-process confirmation and initial stride observations
entries.limitations: Copy ratios cover a fixed size and four processes; gather has one initial sweep. Runtime cache policy is unverified, and logical GB/s is not DRAM bandwidth.

entries.title: mcTracer exit status, kernel events, and unverified exported time units
entries.limitations: Evidence applies to this trace version. Raw time units are not independently verified and are not converted to calibrated kernel microseconds. No cache or DRAM performance counters were collected.

entries.title: C550 function attribute 512, 1024-thread launches, and runtime recompilation
sources: https://developer.metax-tech.com/api/client/document/preview/编程参考/运行时API编程指南/曦云C500系列/3.5.3.x/split_files/编译和调试.html#binary-cache
entries.limitations: Copy on the stated C550/MXCC environment only. Each first-launch host interval is one fresh-process observation, not a general speedup. Recompilation flags are descriptor properties; a missing flag is not false.

entries.title: Fixed-address read permutations on C550: nonmonotonic timings and six-process confirmation
entries.limitations: Different shifts produce different output permutations. A fixed total span does not fix short-term reuse. Six processes on one C550 cannot uniquely attribute behavior to cache, TLBs, or transaction organization, or establish a speedup for the original operator.

entries.title: C550 transpose: controlled tiling, row-pitch, and dynamic shared-memory comparisons
entries.limitations: One dynamic kernel separates request size from row pitch; the request-size response depends on shape. Requested or reported bytes do not establish physical allocation or occupancy. Absolute static-versus-dynamic differences remain confounded by code generation.

entries.title: C550 wave64: shuffle, reduction, and mask parameter types
sources: https://developer.metax-tech.com/api/client/document/preview/编程参考/MXMACA%20C%2B%2B编程指南/曦云C500系列/3.5.3.x/split_files/c_语言扩展.html#warp-shuffle

entries.limitations: The two full typed masks select 64- and 32-element semantic groups in this SDK; physical wave width remains 64. Type and mask value change together, so this is neither a type-only causal comparison nor a same-operator speed comparison. Sparse masks, overflow, and floating-point reduction are untested.

entries.title: C550 WMMA exactness: adjacent product magnitudes at a fixed result
sources: https://developer.metax-tech.com/api/client/document/preview/编程参考/MXMACA%20C%2B%2B编程指南/曦云C500系列/3.5.3.x/split_files/c_语言扩展.html#warp-matrix
entries.limitations: For paired products (q, -(q+1))/256 in the declared factorization, every integer q1–6 is exact and q7–14 has one C00 residual of -2^-31, despite a fixed exact sum -1/256. Both components and all scalar controls are exact. This finite grid establishes no universal threshold, internal precision or unique hardware cause. Only q1/q12/q14 pairs have primary traces; timings are not accepted as performance.
